question:
dentify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The microscopic chip that emits a uniqe signal has been embedded into your arm.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"uniqe"** is misspelt and should be corrected to **"unique"**. (अद्वितीय)
 
• **"Unique" **refers to something that is one of a kind and unlike anything else.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a unique talent for playing the violin.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Embedded** (समाहित): Fixed firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass.

 
 
• **Example:** The nails were embedded in the wood.
 
 
 
• **Emits** (निकलता है): To produce and discharge something, especially gas or radiation.
 
 
• **Example: **The factory emits a lot of smoke.
 
 
 
• **Microscopic** (सूक्ष्म): So small that it can only be seen with a microscope.
 
 
• **Example:** Bacteria are microscopic organisms.
